Commentary.Commentary: We are back. A par score to chase for Afghanistan but it will not be an easy task against the force of Shaheen Afridi and Naseem Shah. The former is all set to steam in. Let's play...
...THE CHASE...

Right then, Afghanistan need 202 runs to get over the line here and take an early lead in this series. They are coming into this series after a comprehensive win over Bangladesh, and would be confident to replicate the same here. Afghanistan do have enough batting prowess to get them home, but this Pakistan bowling line-up it nothing less than dangerous. We are certainly up for an exciting run chase. Do join us shortly for the same...

Elation for Afghanistan and rightly so, they were on top from the get go. Hashmatullah Shahidi was exceptional with his bowling changes as well throughout the innings. Fazalhaq Farooqi and Mujeeb Ur Rahman, the new ball bowlers for this Afghanistan side got them off to a flier, as they took a wicket each in their very first over, and soon Rashid Khan repeated the same feat. So, three bowlers struck for Afghanistan in their respective first overs and had put a strangle of this Pakistan side early on. Mujeeb Ur Rahman was exceptional up top, as he got rid of two big fishes in Babar Azam and Mohammad Rizwan. The batters who certainly are capable enough of taking the game away from the opposition. It were the spinners who dominated the proceedings here, as four spinners chipped in with 8 wickets in total. This does not mean the seamers did not do anything at all, they made sure to keep the pressure intact with their incredible bowling.

This is not what Pakistan would've envisioned for themselves in the first match of this third-match ODI series. Pakistan's coach wanted them to score at a good rate, take the risk, and be aggressive, but they could hardly do any of these things when they came out to bat here on this sluggish wicket. No other batter than Imam-ul-Haq really shined with the bat for them. If not for his half-century things could've been worse for Pakistan. Also, Imam-ul-Haq had some ladyluck by his side, as he miscued plenty of shots, but some landed safely, while a couple of time the Afghan fielders could not judge it well, but other than that Afghanistan would be really pleased with their effort with the ball, as this is the first time they have bundled out Pakistan in an ODI game. Pakistan though have their task-cut out, and their bowlers need to bring their A-game here.

We are just halfway through the clash here in Hambantota and guess what it is Afghanistan that bossed in the most part of the innings. Undoutedly, they will be the happier side heading into the break. Nevertheless, Pakistan have managed to walk back with some kind of a psychological advantage as they crossed the 200-run mark which at one stage was looking quite unlikely.

Commentary.Commentary: Okay then, we are done with all the pre-match proceedings. Time for some cricketing action now, as both these nations are playing away from here, no real home support can be seen, but expect it to be a housefull encounter when these two side meet in the Asia Cup. For now though, the Afghanistan players take the field. Fakhar Zaman and Imam-ul-Haq stride out to the middle for Pakistan with their swords. Fazalhaq Farooqi, the left-arm seamer gets the ball in hand. Here we go...
Both the teams now stride on the field and line-up for their respective national anthems. It will be Pakistan's first followed by the one for Afghanistan.

The stage is set. The sun is out and shining and these two teams are ready to battle it out in Sri Lanka, a crucial series for both these sides as the Asia Cup and the World Cup is just around the corner.

Hashmatullah Shahidi, the captain of Afghanistan says that their target will be to play a good game of cricket and not let them score more runs than them. Informs that they have good fast bowling attack as well and they are trying their best to work hard on their combination of spinners and pacers.

Babar Azam, the captain of Pakistan is in for a chat. He starts by informing that they will bat first. The pitch seems to be dry and they will try to put runs on the board. Informs that Afghanistan have good spinners in their ranks and they will be focused on doing well. States that they just need to believe in themselves and play the natural game.

Pitch Report - There is hardly any grass present on this deck. The pace bowlers will certainly feast on it, with the new ball. 260 seems to be a good score while batting first. The boundaries are slightly on the bigger side as well, so the 2s and 3s will be crucial. This is much more different from the usual deck at Hambantota.
